newsitem.title: EGYPT: Stagnant trading deflates Egypt share prices.
newsitem.headline: Stagnant trading deflates Egypt share prices.

text.p: Egyptian share prices slid lower on Sunday in what brokers called a stagnant, directionless market in sore need of new investments.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index fell 1.4 points to 355.83 points in quiet trading worth 54.24 million pounds ($15.98 million).

"It was really quiet today. There's no real movement in prices, all they're doing is see-sawing in a certain range. People are bored and they're beginning to lose hope," said broker Youssef Khalil of Delta EAB.
The market has closed lower four out of the last five trading days. Brokers attributed Sunday's languid trading to investors sussing out the market.

"The same people are putting the same money in and out of the market. We are badly in need of new cash injections, new investors, new blood," said broker Yasser Darwish of El-Rashad Securities Brokerage.
The cement and banking sectors continued to dominate the market. Amriyah Cement was the day's most active share with trade worth 8.46 million pounds but shares closed 2.5 pounds lower at 81.
Helwan Portland Cement and Suez Cement were also active but ended mixed. Suez climbed 0.51 pounds to 67.5 while Helwan fell 0.69 to 71.31 pounds.
"The cements are attractive at these prices but then the buyers don't want to raise the prices for themselves so they're buying in little blocks every day," Darwish said.
Brokers said Commercial International Bank (CIB) was active in ex-dividend trading. The bank disappointed investors by giving out a two pound dividend for 1996 and shares slipped 1.7 pounds to 70.25.

Milling firms also put a brief showing in Sunday's overall trading. North Cairo Flour Mills was the most attractive, and shares rose 2.94 pounds to 187.44 after shares worth 5.11 million pounds traded.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 495.46 points from 497.76 points on Thursday while that for the rarely traded "closed" firms fell to 260.96 points from 261.90 points.
Out of the 106 shares traded, 33 rose, 39 fell while 34 ended unchanged.
